Detailed Telemetry Engineering Notes

Continuous downlink spectral density measurements confirmed robust signal lock during the entire trans-orbital passage. Cross-polarization discrimination surpassed the 28 dB threshold across all carrier frequencies, maintaining clean signal separation.

Internal telemetry logs recorded zero uncorrectable Reed-Solomon packet faults over 14 million transmitted bytes. Thermal cycle dissipation stayed well within the radiative margin, with heat pipe conductance operating at 98.6% of theoretical peak performance.
